entries.title: Blue Lock Clicker 0.2.0 Update
entries.body:
Blue Lock Clicker has been updated to version 0.2.0.

New Features:
- TONS of new plushies that now go up to 100,000!
- Plushies now have no background making them look better.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Total Clicks Counter going weird when going above 10,000.
- Fixed buttons in shop appearing weird on certain resolutions.

A LOT MORE next update as well as important bug fixes which I have been informed about!

entries.title: First release
entries.text: - Fully playable version of Blue Lock Clicker
